The '''Assassin sect''' was a group within the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]].

==Overview==
The [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] were a group within the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[priest caste]] who were [[Shaper caste|Shaped]] to be agile and deadly with the intention of attacking their enemies as well as incapacitating them quickly. This meant that they were not as powerful as a member of the [[warrior caste]].

==History==
A member of a specialist assassin sect was assigned as the bodyguard to [[Priest/Legends|Priest]] [[Harrar]] during the mission to capture [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] when she fled to the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. He attended to create a unique specialist bodyguard unit to serve him when he claimed a [[Planet/Legends|world]] for himself during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
